scope: Independent historical verification without reopening locked publisher pages.
source_wording_basis: Previously authorized saved-source comparison recorded in Publisher-Questions.json and publisher-second-review.json.

primary_evidence.source: Lok Sabha Secretariat, Journal of Parliamentary Information, June 1989
primary_evidence.finding: Charan Singh resigned on the morning the House was to meet, without facing the House even for a single day.

primary_evidence.source: Lok Sabha Secretariat, Journal of Parliamentary Information, June 1998
primary_evidence.finding: His confidence motion was admitted for 20 August 1979 but could not be moved because he resigned that day.

bilingual_review: Both language versions identify the same four former Prime Ministers and ask for the one who did not face Parliament during the premiership; the recovered Telugu wording is preserved rather than silently normalized.
